Eng9 P22 ordinary COM observations, 2026-11-03

Seven supplemental scenarios request ten fresh-required trials each; summary.json lists the completed subset. Success means the probe ran, not that Excel matched a prediction. Every operation result and handler trace is retained. Each result includes its original raw-result hash and full session receipt; the first trial artifacts and exact loaded/intended VBA source are included per scenario. Original raw files remain in C:/Work/DnaCalc/codex-runs/excel-results-eng9/p22-com.

This uses the existing P01-P10 Stage/Snap/Typed logger through COM. Diagnostic macro snapshots are separate from the external command records. The probe supports Automatic/Manual writes, same-value writes, clearing, calculation scopes, saves, Undo, cancel-only, edit-and-cancel, guarded nested handlers and events disabled where the scenario requests them. Only cases and trial counts listed in summary.json have been observed in this snapshot. UI paste/Redo, two-sheet placement, async/RTD publication, cross-workbook events and the remaining P06 replay jobs remain unrun. Completed P06 trial observations, if any, are retained separately in p06-observations.jsonl. Per-trial CPU, Office channel and executable file version are missing from P22 metadata; version/build/locale, MTC/thread count and OS are retained. No UI-event ordering or engine policy is inferred. VBA project access was already available; no registry or Trust Center setting was changed. Initial setup and the final artifact save are retained separately from the commands.
